spread: embedded in assumed ask/bid execution prices; extra slippage charged once separately
filters: assumed bid <= ask for each product
exclude every conflicting duplicate timestamp; collapse exact duplicates with provenance
assumed regular clock 08:45..15:45; on referenced expiry no later than11:30
continuity: signals and fills only across exact 60-second adjacency within same date/reference contract; no carry signal across gaps
censor_policy: Never fabricate a roll or close across unobserved intervals. An open position at a gap or session boundary is unverifiable, not realized. No forced liquidation.
annual_chain: single initial cash, no calendar resets; stop financial chain at first unverifiable open position; no annual return after censoring
auxiliary_segments: separate independent contiguous-observation episodes, each with disclosed reference initial cash; never combine their scores as annual return; no reset at month or quarter boundary merely because calendar changed
borrowing: reverse-direction theoretical; availability and borrowing fees unverified, not certified zero
